issues.detail: Spec does not define start_shifting value on synchronous reset; contract chooses 0.
issues.alternative: start_shifting retains its pre-reset value on a synchronous reset edge, while state still goes to S0.

issues.detail: Spec does not define start_shifting before 1101 is detected; contract chooses 0.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: after reset releases, start_shifting is 1 until 1101 is detected, while reset clears it to 0.
